# Go toolchains for CI, read by .github/scripts/setup-go.sh.
# Format: <key> <os>-<arch> <Go version in the archive's VERSION file> <archive URL> <sha256>
#
# setup-go.sh picks the line for the key and the runner's platform.
#
# The MetaCubeX/go `build` release holds one patched toolchain per Go minor
# version and replaces the assets in place when it is rebuilt. When that
# happens setup-go.sh fails with a SHA-256 mismatch: look at what changed in
# the release, then put the new version and digest here
# (`gh release view build -R MetaCubeX/go --json assets`).
#
# loong64-abi1 is the Go 1.26.0 toolchain that builds for the old LoongArch
# ABI (the loong64-abi1 release target); it only runs on linux-amd64.
# MetaCubeX/loongarch64-golang has no newer 1.26.x release yet (2026-10-17).
1.26 linux-amd64 go1.26.11 https://github.com/MetaCubeX/go/releases/download/build/go1.26.linux-amd64.tar.gz f2f3aab2fc72a4d4dd0123e088ed6611526b50b4e82d4c234ec24772ffb16981
1.26 linux-arm64 go1.26.11 https://github.com/MetaCubeX/go/releases/download/build/go1.26.linux-arm64.tar.gz e4c099666d4e6e109b11ef6180cb5473690b9f0952083526ecd9a13fc66aa1d4
1.26 darwin-amd64 go1.26.11 https://github.com/MetaCubeX/go/releases/download/build/go1.26.darwin-amd64.tar.gz b5d26bf7a4520d3d8ebc31872231ba42b5a24366eb36f5a174ccec0c975b0d85
1.26 darwin-arm64 go1.26.11 https://github.com/MetaCubeX/go/releases/download/build/go1.26.darwin-arm64.tar.gz c04baacf2c65634d4d024c6e12e52f14539227ee36f5f37fc1de80c18608d8a3
1.26 windows-amd64 go1.26.11 https://github.com/MetaCubeX/go/releases/download/build/go1.26.windows-amd64.zip 0c864c2d6e39b6fab62dc3a491a2d43d3c0d3e9ae70117e04148601159820237
1.26 windows-arm64 go1.26.11 https://github.com/MetaCubeX/go/releases/download/build/go1.26.windows-arm64.zip b8e9841b9a43a3397b1c8a6717b00d838f78cd320a81c8d62e42748f34aaf2f1
